name: Mariemur

prices.note: Lingerie > Bras collection products.json (store currency USD, Shopify.country US): 27 bras, all regular price (no compare_at above price), all in stock. Low: Joan Bra and Joan Lacquer Bra $89; Ivy, June and Nensi Bra $99; high: Alba Bra $139, Maeve Bra $169 (sold with gloves). Median $119. Every bra is sized XS, S, M, L, XL, 2XL.

notes: Homepage title: Luxury Leather, Lingerie, Bras and More for Women; meta description: luxury lingerie featuring strappy lingerie, leather harnesses, designer lingerie sets, sheer lingerie and statement intimates (https://mariemur.com/).

Shipping page (footer link): US Standard $12.90 (3 to 6 business days), Priority $15.90 (2 to 4), free on orders over $350 USD; ships next business day; US shopping is tax-free apart from local taxes; no PO Boxes, BFPO or APO/FPO (https://mariemur.com/pages/shipping). Older unlinked shipping-policy page lists the US under Shipping from US Warehouse (https://mariemur.com/pages/shipping-policy).

Returns page (footer link): 45 days from delivery to start a return; leather bras, lingerie bras and lingerie bodysuits are returnable; lingerie panties, latex, leather garters and full bodies, and some hosiery are not; US customers get free return shipping labels; refund to original payment or store credit; RMA address BRANDFOX - MARIEMUR, 400 Capital Lane 100, Middletown, PA 17057 (https://mariemur.com/pages/returns). An older unlinked return-policy page still says 30 days (https://mariemur.com/pages/return-policy); 45 days is used because the footer and FAQ both say 45.
FAQ: real Italian leather; discreet outer box with a red branded MARIEMUR box inside; personal fitting sessions with customer support; 45 days to return (https://mariemur.com/pages/faq-mariemur).
Country selector lists United States, Canada, United Kingdom and Australia; shipping page covers the US, Europe, UK, Canada and Australia (https://mariemur.com/pages/shipping).
Bra size chart: US/UK bands 30 to 44 mapped to underbust 25 to 40.5 inches; bras themselves are sold in XS to 2XL (https://mariemur.com/pages/bra-sizechart).

hq_country US and founded 2017 come from the CB Insights profile (30 North Gould Street Suite R, Sheridan, Wyoming, a registered-agent style address), not from the brand's own site, which names no HQ (https://www.cbinsights.com/company/mariemur).
